jobs.description:
Our client is an industrial organisation in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Manager your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate day-to-day office activities to ensure an organised and efficient workplace.
• Manage office supplies and place orders to maintain availability of essential materials.
• Arrange meetings and prepare meeting rooms for internal and external visitors.
• Handle incoming calls, emails and correspondence, ensuring timely follow-up.
• Maintain administrative records and keep office documentation accurate and accessible.
• Coordinate with external suppliers for office-related services and practical requests.
• Support the organisation of business travel, appointments and calendar planning.
• Identify office needs and coordinate actions that help daily operations run smoothly.

A successful Office Manager should have:

• At least two years of experience coordinating office administration and daily workplace activities.
• Ability to work in English and French or Dutch, at least B2 level is required for two of these languages.
• Ability to manage calendars, meetings, correspondence and practical office requests.
• Confidence working with office documentation, records and administrative processes.
• Ability to coordinate suppliers and follow up on office-related services.
• Strong organisational skills to manage several priorities in a structured way.
• A clear and professional approach to communication with colleagues and visitors.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international manufacturing and distribution company recognised for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Operating across multiple markets, the organisation offers a fast-paced and collaborative environment where teamwork and continuous improvement drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN your responsibilities are:

• Manage the complete order-to-cash process for a portfolio of domestic and international customers.
• Process, release, and monitor customer orders received through various channels, including e-commerce platforms, email, phone, and EDI.
• Provide customers with timely updates regarding order status, product availability, pricing, promotions, shipment tracking, and related documentation.
• Maintain accurate customer purchase order records within the ERP system for compliance and audit purposes.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and Planning teams to validate customer demand against inventory availability.
• Manage backorders proactively and communicate alternative solutions when supply shortages arise.
• Coordinate shipments from multiple production sites and third-party suppliers while ensuring on-time delivery.
• Prepare and verify shipping, export, and customer-specific documentation.
• Handle debit and credit note administration.
• Respond to customer enquiries and manage claims related to logistics, quality, pricing, warranty, transport, and other service issues.
• Escalate complex cases according to internal procedures and ensure prompt resolution.
• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, and Product teams.
• Produce operational reports and analyse business data to support decision-making.
• Identify opportunities for process optimisation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the implementation of best practices and departmental performance standards.

A successful Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN should have:

• Holds a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Has initial experience within Customer Service, Customer Support, Order Management, Sales Administration, or Supply Chain Administration.
• Is fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Possesses a good working knowledge of French.
• Additional language skills are considered a strong asset.
• Has experience working with ERP systems, ideally SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).
• Demonstrates excellent proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
• Has strong communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Is customer-focused and solutions-oriented.
• Can work independently while also being an effective team player.
• Remains calm and efficient in a fast-paced environment.
• Displays strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Adopts a continuous improvement mindset and strives for service excellence.

The company is a not-for-profit making organisation which represents large, medium and small companies across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

Mission of the role:

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?

For the Executive Director, you will:

• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc.
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits….
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents).
• Manage the Extranet/Website.
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:

• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

DHL Aviation, DHL Express’s sorting center in Belgium, is the beating heart of package transport at the airport.The brand-new building is a showcase of automation and technology in the field of logistics. Shipments are delivered by truck or plane from all over the world, consolidated at Brucargo, and sorted for their final destinations. These shipments are then loaded onto trucks or planes again and transported to their final destinations.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).
•  You have a basic knowledge of Dutch (level A1, your level will be put to the test).
• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.
• You are willing to improve your knowledge of Dutch (DHL offers Dutch learning sessions during the working hours).
• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
• You are able to get to work on your behalf
• You are looking forward to having an energetic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy shipments ( /- 25 kg on a regular basis)
• Working safely comes first for you.
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.
